title: Vanilla Mob Variety Pack
description:
This is a simple data pack that adds variation to the passive and hostile mobs without breaking the vanilla feel of the game.

At the moment the mobs have a chance to vary in size but i will add more vanilla mob variants in the future!
body:
This is a simple data pack that adds variation to the passive and hostile mobs without breaking the vanilla feel of the game.

Current features:
- passive and hostile mobs will vary in size, including changes to their stats

Future features:
- biome specific variants for every hostile mob


please let me know on discord if there are any bugs or balance problems!
